name: TT-SGP(25)
short_description: Shot gun patterning target by Target Telemetrics
description:
TT-SGP Shotgun Patterning Target by Target Telemetrics

Professional shotgun patterning made easy with patented smartphone app technology

The TT-SGP is a specialized shotgun patterning target designed to work seamlessly with Target Telemetrics’ FREE smartphone apps for instant, accurate pattern analysis. This innovative target eliminates the tedious manual work of shotgun pattern analysis, providing detailed results in just seconds.

Key Features

  • Instant Digital Analysis: Compatible with Target Telemetrics’ patented “At-the-Range” analysis technology
  • Professional Results: Get detailed and accurate analysis for YOUR GUN-YOUR CHOKE-YOUR AMMO combination
  • Easy to Use: Simply shoot the target, photograph it, enter your ammo data, and press “Analyze”
  • Comprehensive Data: Provides pattern offset, windage, elevation, pattern density, and percent of pellets within analysis circle

What’s Included

  • 25 high-quality shotgun patterning targets per pack
  • Access to FREE Target Telemetrics apps (iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac)
  • Detailed target photography guidelines
  • Instructions for optimal results

Compatible Apps (FREE Download)

  • Shotgun Profiler – Automatic shotgun patterning tool with advanced features:
    • Auto-detect pellet holes for pattern analysis
    • Compute pattern density and percent of pellets within analysis circles
    • Killzone and gap analysis with survival paths and pattern voids
    • Uniformity map view
    • Support for English and metric units
    • Desktop version includes multiple target averaging and data export to spreadsheets

Target Care Instructions

For optimal automatic scoring and analysis results:

  • Don’t crease or fold targets – roll them similar to shipping method
  • Store in dry indoor location until ready to use
  • Don’t mark or write on targets except in designated border areas
  • Mount targets flat and photograph while completely flat to edges
  • Use cardboard backing for cleaner hit definition

Photography Guidelines for Best Results

  • Camera Resolution: Minimum 4 megapixels required
  • Alignment: Hold camera directly in line with target’s center
  • Lighting: Minimize shadows, capture at least 2 inches of border around target
  • Stability: Hold camera steady and avoid compression when taking photos
  • Positioning: Best results when photo is taken with target still mounted on backer

Technical Specifications

  • Designed for shotgun pattern analysis and profiling
  • Compatible with all shotgun gauges and choke combinations
